title: Generalisations lift along the support of a finite flat module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a finite module flat over the base ring, generalisations lift along the support of the module (statement lines 10068-10073). The proof unwinds the topological statement into a concrete demand for a smaller prime of the source over a smaller prime of the base and produces it by tensoring the localised module with the residue field of the smaller base prime, keeping the relevant sequences exact by flatness (proof lines 10075-10099). Choosing the residue field tensor product as the ring in which to exhibit that prime is the step that carries the argument. H2.
